Later Specimen work corrected the copied definition text and evolved the original CodeableReference form into the current collection.device[x] choices, including Reference(Device) and canonical(DeviceDefinition).
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini keeps Specimen in build scope, and source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml currently defines Specimen.collection.device[x] as 0..1 with a device-focused short/definition and CodeableConcept, Reference(Device), and canonical(DeviceDefinition) choices.
